text:
Priya: Heads-up — Fathom Health raised a couple of recurring issues during onboarding this week. pasted notes below.

Priya: TL;DR: (1) their team sees hallucinated references in the reranker outputs, (2) confusion on per-route billing for embeddings, and (3) enablement docs unclear on cache warmup.

Priya: customer quote: ```The search results sometimes invent clinics that don't exist, and we can't map cost to our API routes — finance is worried. Also our SRE didn't see any guidance for pre-warming the prefix cache.```

Janelle: thanks — putting this in product triage. can we get a short repro for the hallucination case? ideally minimal prompt + input.

Sam: I captured the session recording and a sample payloads.json from their QA run. uploading to the ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-8812

Maya: curious if they're on a quantized variant or using a trimmed context window. hallucinations like that sometimes correlate with aggressive truncation. Sam — can you share model+variant and tokenization stats?

Sam: model is gptx-4b-compat, quantized int8, route: /embed-search, seq len ~1024 in their tests. payload snippet: ```{"route":"embed-search","model":"gptx-4b-compat-quant","input_count":12}```

Leo: on billing confusion — customer expects one line item per logical route. our per-route billing maps to per-endpoint-id, which can combine multiple internal routes. Ben, can enablement update the docs to show mapping table?

Ben: yep — I'll draft a short matrix mapping endpoint-ids -> UI names -> billing key. will include a FAQ: "why does my invoice show endpoint_x instead of /search" :memo:

Priya: also need a short playbook for cache warmup. suggested steps: 1) run a short synthetic session with representative prefixes, 2) set short-lived warmup TTL via runtime flag, 3) monitor KV hit rate in console.

Maya: runtime flag exists (kv.prefix_warm=true). I'll add an example CLI snippet for ops: ```rwictl warm --endpoint embed-search --prefill-file examples/warm.json --parallel 4```

Janelle: action items: (A) Sam attach logs+payloads to triage ticket (B) Maya engineer note + warmup CLI snippet (C) Ben update billing mapping doc + enablement slide (D) Product to prioritize hallucination regression — need severity estimate by Wednesday.

Sam: attached. cc: @cs-bot for follow-up reminders.

cs-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 72 hours for CS-8812. :alarm_clock:

Priya: FYI — customer is at risk if finance can't reconcile cost. mark as renewal watch. putting a soft hold on auto-renew alerts.

Janelle: noted. I'll slot this into Thursday's product sync (15m).

Ben: will draft the enablement slide and ping @Priya when ready for review.

Maya: making a short repro branch with a failing case to show to model team. linking here when done.

Priya: thanks team — short, focused fixes please. customer is receptive to a combed walk-through next week. :handshake:
